unit.why: A short narrative about a holy man in 'our generation' martyred after a blood libel, who dies through devekut. It is cited from a book as an illustration within a homily on thought.

stories.start_quote: הנה שמעתי שבדורנו העלילו וכו׳ דם
stories.summary_en: A holy man falsely accused in a blood libel fasts all week, is impaled by gentiles near the Sabbath, and sings hymns while dying. He feels no pain because of his devekut, and his soul departs through his cleaving to God rather than through the killing.

quotes: מרוב דביקות מחשבתו באהבה עזה ועצומה
הוא המית את עצמו ע״י דבוק מחשבתו
tags.why: Rapt cleaving to God makes him insensible to pain

quotes: ע״י דבוק מחשבתו בו ית׳ ונשארה דבוקה שם
tags.why: His soul cleaves to God and departs

quotes: הי' מזמר שירות ותשבחות באהבה עזה

tags.why: Joy in his soul's coming delight
The killing takes place on Sabbath eve, near Kiddush

quotes: וכסבורין הגוי׳ שע״י הריג׳ נפרדה נשמתו מגופו
tags.why: The gentiles are the accusers and the executioners

quotes: העלילו וכו׳ דם שקר על איש קדוש אחד
tags.why: The blood libel sets him against the gentiles

quotes: העתידה לבא לאחר שעה מועט בג״ע
tags.why: Gan Eden appears as his soul's destination, not as a setting
The tale is framed by a homily on thought and devekut and cited from a derush
It illustrates the martyr's love of God and devekut

missing_concepts: insensibility to pain through mystical absorption
